title: Absciss

inlines.v: AB'SCISS, noun [Latin abscissus, from ab and scindere, to cut; See Scissors.] In conics, a part of the diameter, or transverse axis of a conic section, intercepted between the vertex or some other fixed point, and a semiordinate.
